description: Search Vealth's public board of real ecological and community work packets. Each result includes the pay, the skill level, the exact proof that gets it approved, and a page URL. Free, no account, no wallet. Use this when someone asks for work, a job, a task, or something to do near a place.

flag.description: One posting flag, exact match, e.g. vsh_eligible — the packets that carry Regen Network proposal 77's terms (accepted hours pay REGEN, never a USD conversion). Omit for every flag.

funded.description: true = only packets a verified payment already backs (money truth; a funded packet can still be earned_credit and never promise cash — read payModel); false = only unfunded packets, where approved proof records earned credit rather than cash unless later funded. Omit for both.

latitude.description: Center of the search. Only if you already have real coordinates.

longitude.description: Center of the search. Only if you already have real coordinates.

near.description: A place in plain words: a city, neighborhood, address, or ZIP, e.g. 'Los Angeles, CA' or '90036'. Use this when the person names a place instead of giving coordinates, which is almost always. The board finds the place from the open jobs whose address names every word (so 'Los Angeles' never matches 'Los Fresnos'), then returns the jobs around it, nearest first.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The reply says when more pages exist.

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'storm drain' or 'tree planting'. Typo-tolerant.

radiusKm.description: Search radius in km, used with latitude/longitude. Default 50.

remote.description: true = only work doable from anywhere (digital/self-verifying — what an agent with no field presence can complete); false = only placed field work. Omit for both.

name: find_work
title: Find real work nearby
